name: io.github.dragoscv/axiom
title: AXIOM
description: Transactional write gate for coding agents: plan, canonical manifest, checks, two-phase apply.

packageArguments.name: --root
packageArguments.description: Absolute repository root AXIOM may write to (allowlist; repeatable). There is no cwd fallback.

environmentVariables.name: AXIOM_SIGNING_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional Ed25519 private key (base64 PKCS#8 or raw seed) used by axiom_sign; never stored under a root.
